ambient_events: The reload hoist clanks a half-cycle and settles.
A radar repeater sweeps its slow green line across a cracked screen.
Overhead, the ring mount grinds as the gun tracks — dust sifts down from the ceiling.
description: The bunker under the Guardian battery — a low concrete box lit by caged worklights and the green wash of a radar repeater. Belted ammunition snakes up into the feed throat of the gun above; the reload hoist and a wall of spare barrels and coolant bottles crowd one side. This is where the battery is actually kept alive: when a strafing run guts the gun overhead, it's patched, re-armed, and brought back online down here. A steel ladder climbs to the hatch and the open gun deck.
name: Guardian Battery — Bunker
